explanation: The observed Job-2 priorities all have upstream_rank 0 because the evidence_sources handoff uses source ids as record_id values, so downstream coverage record ids n06-r01..n06-r08 cannot match provenance ranks. The supplied upstream function assemble_provenance is the source of that malformed handoff: it writes record_id from source_id instead of preserving the demand record_id while also carrying source_id.
cited_evidence: assemble_provenance source appends {'record_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_id': record.get('source_id', ''), ...}, replacing demand record ids with source ids.
Job-2 input evidence_sources contains record_id values s01 through s08, while Job-2 needs and coverage use record_id values n06-r01 through n06-r08.
Job-2 observed priorities show upstream_rank: 0 for every record, demonstrating the provenance ranks were not preserved across the upstream-to-downstream handoff.
